data.headline: Net loans rose 16.8% quarter over quarter

claims.text: Net loans and leases rose to $877.4 million at June 30, 2026 from $751.2 million at March 31, 2026, an increase of $126.2 million, or 16.8% quarter over quarter.

citation.quote: RC RCONB529 Loans and leases, net of unearned income and allowance 877440 751213 579753

claims.text: Real estate is a named component of the loan portfolio, alongside commercial and industrial and consumer and other loans.

citation.quote: Loan portfolio segment: Commercial Real Estate | $487,265 | $346,191 Residential Real Estate | 201,153 | 79,667 Commercial and Industrial | 189,094 | 146,828 Consumer and Other | 8,396 | 19,877

claims.text: Patriot’s lending activities have historically been conducted primarily in Connecticut, New York and New Jersey, tying the loan book to those regional economies.

citation.quote: Patriot’s lending activities have historically been conducted primarily in the Tri-State areas of Connecticut, New York and New Jersey.

claims.text: Borrowers’ ability and willingness to satisfy loan obligations can depend on regional economic and real estate market conditions.

citation.quote: The ability and willingness of borrowers to satisfy their loan obligations can be dependent to some degree on the regional economy and real estate market conditions.
